# Oat vendor record

The package contains the Oat HTML, CSS, and JavaScript foundation with this
pinned identity:

- Commit: `32955ad1b65be51f13bc6be802611de80db9e357`
- License: MIT

The verbatim license is in `LICENSE.oat`. Vendored CSS and JavaScript live in

`oat-theme.css`.
